The normalized Caltech and Office 1 session extracts originate from [Caltech ACN-Data](https://ev.caltech.edu/dataset), via [Amara-Ouali and coauthors' research mirror](https://github.com/yvenn-amara/ev-load-open-data/tree/3b1cb67d1b02f8fea0451c16fbcfaee34449ce46/1.%20Input%20Data/7.%20ACN%20Data). The mirror's GPL-3.0 notice is retained in [ACN_MIRROR_LICENSE.md](ACN_MIRROR_LICENSE.md); these external data are separate from the application's MIT license.

Credit Zachary J. Lee, Tongxin Li and Steven H. Low, “ACN-Data: Analysis and Applications of an Open EV Charging Dataset,” ACM e-Energy, 2019; and Yvenn Amara-Ouali, Yannig Goude, Pascal Massart, Jean-Michel Poggi and Hui Yan, “A Review of Electric Vehicle Load Open Data and Models,” 2021. PowerFlex Systems enabled the original dataset.

Changes: selected date/site slices, normalized timestamps/units, stripped personal fields, added anonymous session aliases and request-as-of-arrival filtering. Provenance, transformations and original-source hashes are in adjacent manifests/metadata and [data-sources.md](../../docs/data-sources.md). The mirror's original extraction/timezone history remains unverified. Delivered energy/unplug time are not online requirements; equipment ratings are not vehicle acceptance measurements. No upstream raw JSON or personal identifiers are redistributed here.
